Description
With international student success and happiness as key priorities, ULethbridge International College Calgary (UICC) provides its learners with support and guidance within a welcoming, inclusive environment.This formula translates into success in the classroom, and instilling the skills and confidence in graduates to make a difference in their professional careers.
